title: TLS certificates generated and trusted locally by default
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Generate a local CA and server certs on first run, trust them for localhost clients, and remove tls_cert_path/tls_key_path as required settings. Tests zc_tls_auto_*.
